blocks.text: MY STORY Tall Timbers, Maryland 2007 to 2025 Monday, January 20 2025 Tall Timbers, Maryland My life started in Tall Timbers, Maryland. My father Henry and my mother Piper brought me up. My sister Valerie and my brother Jacob are younger than I am. At the age of 5, I started at Tall Timbers Public Schools. My father is a county administrator at St. Mary's County. My mother moved from Chapman and Associates to Trevino Trucking as a dispatcher when I was 17. I turned eighteen. I made Patrick McLeod a promise. I gave Ray Velez my word. I knew Ray. Ray took on the job of a commissioner.
